title: Preserve visible page content after hidden HTML void elements
problem:
Reproduced: PageText fed

Visible tail

returns an empty text string. A hidden void element has no closing tag, but currently leaves the parser inside a hidden subtree forever.
acceptance_criteria: Hidden HTML void elements do not suppress subsequent visible text or links. Cover all standard void tags and both hidden and aria-hidden="true".
Both ordinary void syntax and self-closing void syntax preserve subsequent content.
Non-void hidden subtrees and script/style content remain suppressed; void elements nested within hidden containers do not break correct recovery at the container end.
Ordinary visible text, HTML character references, title extraction, and relative-link resolution retain their existing behavior.
Add concise standard-library unittest regression tests using synthetic HTML. No network, inference, dependency changes, or changes to existing tests.
exclusions: Only PageText parsing and one new regression-test module. Do not modify page fetching, public_url, DNS pinning, HTTP limits, tool schemas, or other functions. Preserve working parser behavior outside the demonstrated defect.
